factor: single factor: lm_head logits GEMM routing at the LogitsProcessor call site
finding_summary: Spark2_5 ties lm_head to model.embed_tokens (spark2_5.py:462; gguf_name_maps.py:84), which owns only GGUF qweight/qweight_type, no dense weight. LogitsProcessor._compute_lm_head therefore takes the GGUF else branch and calls lm_head.quant_method.apply (logits_processor.py:1203-1213), which reaches fused_mul_mat_gguf (gguf.py:594). With a Q8_0 vocab matrix of 133120 rows that means vendor MMVQ for B<=2 (gguf.py:266-267) and vendor ggml_mul_mat_a8 for 3<=B<=64 (gguf.py:270-273). The research W4 apply() is not reachable from the lm_head site today: coverage requires batch 32..8192 (helper:36-37) and weight rows <= 131072 (helper:38), while decode B is 1..10 and the repo config vocab is 133120. There is no dequantized BF16 GEMM to replace, so the requested narrow routing was not implemented.

implementation.reason: Finding shows lm_head already routes quantized; the task's own rule says implement nothing in that case. Also the 'batch any' guard cannot be made exact against the existing operator (batch 32..8192, rows <= 131072).

blockers: operator admission requires weight.shape[0] <= 131072 (helper:38); vocab 133120 exceeds it
decode B<=2 is claimed by vendor MMVQ before the MMQ branch (gguf.py:266-267)
GGUF lm_head has no .weight, so the should_apply_lm_head_quant_method seam is dead for it (logits_processor.py:146)
research .so is not present in this sandbox and covered() is never true for this matrix at any batch

analysis_notes.lm_head_cost_floor: V*K Q8_0 bytes = 133120*2176 = 289669120 B (~276 MiB) read per decode step at B<=10; this is weight-format-bound and cannot be reduced under the fixed-weights (Q8_0) constraint.
analysis_notes.only_admissible_future_lever: an operator-level admission extension of the research X64/Y64 tile to batch 3..31 (kernel work, out of scope for this round and unsupported by any B<=10 evidence)

risks: Determination depends on the campaign's prior realweights evidence that token_embd.weight is Q8_0; if the runtime GGUF stores it F16/BF16/F32, fused_mul_mat_gguf would take the UNQUANTIZED_TYPES x @ qweight.T branch (gguf.py:263-264) and the finding must be reopened.

Vocab 133120 is the repo config default (configs/spark2_5.py:77) because the model-directory config.json is absent from this read-only sandbox; the B<32 blocker is vocab-independent, the 131072 row-cap blocker is not.
Zero runtime risk: no python/ file changed; gguf.py and logits_processor.py hash-match base 6ee7279.
